ownershipRemediation.reason: The first-pass launcher accepted any 2xx/3xx on port 3210 as a healthy YORISOU application, and accepted a generic next-server as its own purely because that process owned the port. HTTP success is transport, not application identity.
correctedClaims: 'HTTP 200 on 3210' no longer means 'YORISOU is healthy' anywhere in start, stop, or verify.
Process name alone is no longer sufficient for ownership; the legacy yr_pid_is_ours port+name rule was removed entirely.

its working directory resolves to YORISOU_REPO (yr_pid_cwd_matches_repo)
it is the recorded launcher PID or its child (yr_pid_lineage_matches_recorded)
runtime commitSha equals the recorded built SHA (yr_runtime_identity_matches_build)
current grade only: recorded built SHA equals repository HEAD
current grade only: runtime commitRef is consistent with the current branch
